name: @nvidia/nemoclaw-hermes
description: Hermes agent runtime package for NemoClaw

scripts.test:package: vitest run --config vitest.config.ts && python3 -m unittest discover -s plugin -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.test:nemoclaw: npm run test:nemoclaw:parallel && npm run test:nemoclaw:subprocess && npm run test:fabric:composed
scripts.test:nemoclaw:parallel: vitest run --config vitest.nemoclaw.ts --exclude tests/host/package-paths.test.ts --exclude tests/integration/cli-alias.test.ts --exclude tests/integration/provider-onboarding.test.ts --exclude tests/runtime/agent-update.test.ts
scripts.test:nemoclaw:subprocess: vitest run --config vitest.nemoclaw.ts --maxWorkers=1 tests/host/package-paths.test.ts tests/integration/cli-alias.test.ts tests/integration/provider-onboarding.test.ts tests/runtime/agent-update.test.ts
scripts.test:spec: vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --reporter=tree && python3 -m unittest discover -s plugin -p 'test_*.py' && npm run test:nemoclaw:parallel -- --reporter=tree && npm run test:nemoclaw:subprocess -- --reporter=tree
scripts.test: npm run test:package && npm run test:fabric && npm run test:nemoclaw
